country.title: Country
country.description: Optional: country the student lives in.

intendedTerm.title: Intended Term
intendedTerm.description: When they want to start, e.g. Fall 2027.

isInternational.title: International Student
isInternational.description: Optional: true if the student will need an F-1 visa.

notes.title: Conversation Notes
notes.description: 2-4 sentences for the admissions counselor: background, goals, questions asked and what was recommended.

programInterest.title: Program Interest
programInterest.description: Program or programs the student is interested in.

sendEmailSummary.title: Send Email Summary
sendEmailSummary.description: Optional: true to email the student a summary of their program(s) of interest, deadlines and next steps, built from Fordham program records.
